 "data": "classDiagram
 class PdfGenerator {
 <<interface>>
 +generate(InvoiceDocument, CompanyProperties) byte[]
 }
 class OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator {
 -HeaderSectionRenderer header
 -PartiesSectionRenderer parties
 -ItemsTableSectionRenderer items
 -TotalsSectionRenderer totals
 -PaymentSectionRenderer payment
 +generate(InvoiceDocument, CompanyProperties) byte[]
 }
 class InvoiceSectionRenderer {
 <<interface>>
 +render(Document, InvoiceDocument, CompanyProperties)
 }
 class HeaderSectionRenderer
 class PartiesSectionRenderer
 class ItemsTableSectionRenderer
 class TotalsSectionRenderer
 class PaymentSectionRenderer
 class PageFooterEventHandler
 class InvoiceTheme
 class MoneyFormatter
 class StatusPresentation
 class InvoicePdfMapper {
 +toDocument(Invoice, Payment) InvoiceDocument
 }
 class InvoiceDocument {
 <<record/DTO>>
 }

 PdfGenerator <|.. OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator
 InvoiceSectionRenderer <|.. HeaderSectionRenderer
 InvoiceSectionRenderer <|.. PartiesSectionRenderer
 InvoiceSectionRenderer <|.. ItemsTableSectionRenderer
 InvoiceSectionRenderer <|.. TotalsSectionRenderer
 InvoiceSectionRenderer <|.. PaymentSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> HeaderSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> PartiesSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> ItemsTableSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> TotalsSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> PaymentSectionRenderer
 OpenPdfInvoiceGenerator --> PageFooterEventHandler : creates per call
 HeaderSectionRenderer ..> InvoiceTheme
 TotalsSectionRenderer ..> MoneyFormatter
 PaymentSectionRenderer ..> StatusPresentation
 InvoicePdfMapper --> InvoiceDocument",
 "config": null
